create_ModelWrapper: create a ModelWrapper with env, embedder, encoder, decoder, and beam search parameters
run_ModelWrapper_forward: run the ModelWrapper forward pass on bags of sequences to generate symbolic expressions
use_chunks: use the chunks function to yield successive n-sized chunks from a list
review_ModelWrapper_forward: review the ModelWrapper forward method that performs greedy and beam search generation
refactor_ModelWrapper_beam: refactor the ModelWrapper to support additional beam types beyond search and sampling
